src: foreground color groups s, each with its 4-connected monochromatic objects
dst: output rows d ordered top-to-bottom by decreasing object count
match_cond: rank(s.object_count descending) == rank(d top-to-bottom); counts are unique
transform: fill the rightmost s.object_count cells of d with s.color and leave the other cells background
grid_shape: height is number of foreground colors; width is largest object count
